description_en: Queries the details of all client certificates and server certificates
description_zh: 查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的详细信息
name: ListClientCertificate

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of certificates to display on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页显示证书的数量。默认值为20
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the client certificate or server certificate that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html operation to query the unique identifiers of all client certificates and server certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的唯一识别码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html接口获取
parameters.name: resource_group_id

CertificateList.description_en: The list of details about client certificates or server certificates
CertificateList.description_zh: 客户端证书或服务端证书的详情列表

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: 证书的到期日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Algorithm.description_en:
The type of the encryption algorithm used for the certificate. Valid values:

RSA: RSA algorithm
ECC: ECC algorithm
SM2: SM2 algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
证书的加密算法类型。取值：

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

AliasName.description_en: The name set for the issued certificate

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance date of the certificate. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
BeforeDate.description_zh: 证书的签发日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

CertificateType.description_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

CLIENT: client certificate
SERVER: server certificate
CertificateType.description_zh:
证书的类型。取值：

CLIENT：表示客户端证书。
SERVER：表示服务端证书

CommonName.description_en: The common name of the certificate

CountryCode.description_en:
The country code of the organization associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate.

For more information about country codes, see the Country code section in [Manage company information]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）
CountryCode.description_zh:
签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在国家的代码。

关于不同国家代码的含义，请参见[管理公司信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）中的**国际代号**章节

CustomIdentifier.description_en: The custom identifier, which is a unique key
CustomIdentifier.description_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键

Days.description_en: The validity period of the certificate. Unit: days

Id.description_en: The primary key ID of the certificate

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate

KeySize.description_en: The key length of the certificate

Locality.description_en: The name of the city where the organization associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate is located
Locality.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在城市的名称

Md5.description_en: The MD5 fingerprint of the certificate

Organization.description_en: The name of the organization associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate
Organization.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构的名称

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The name of the department under the organization associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构下部门的名称

ParentIdentifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate
ParentIdentifier.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书的唯一识别码

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the certificate belongs

Sans.description_en:
The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension attribute of the certificate, which indicates other domain names and IP addresses associated with the certificate.

This parameter is represented as a string converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct that corresponds to a SAN extension.
Each SAN extension struct includes the following parameters:

Type: the type of the extension. This parameter is of the INTEGER type. Valid values:
1: email address
2: domain name
6: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)
7: IP address
Value: the content of the extension. This parameter is of the STRING type
Sans.description_zh:
证书的SAN（Subject Alternative Name）扩展属性，表示证书关联的其他域名、IP地址等。

该参数使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，对应一个SAN扩展。
每个SAN扩展结构体包含以下参数：

Type：Integer类型，表示扩展的类型。取值：
1：表示邮箱地址。
2：表示域名。
6：表示统一资源标识符URI（Uniform Resource Identifier）。
7：表示IP地址。
Value：String类型，表示扩展的内容

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the certificate

State.description_en:
<props="china">The name of the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the organization associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate is located.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the province or state where the organization associated with the intermediate CA certificate that issued the certificate is located.</props>
State.description_zh:
<props="china">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: The certificate is issued.
REVOKE: The certificate is revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书的状态。取值：

ISSUE：表示正常签发。
REVOKE：表示已被吊销

SubjectDN.description_en:
The distinguished name (DN) attribute of the certificate, which indicates the subject of the certificate. The attribute includes the following information:

C: the country.
O: the organization.
OU: the organizational unit.
L: the locality.
<props="china">- ST: the province, municipality, or autonomous region.</props>
<props="intl">- ST: the province or state.</props>
CN: the common name
SubjectDN.description_zh:
证书的DN（Distinguished Name）属性，表示证书的使用者，具体包含以下信息：

C：国家。
O：组织机构。
OU：部门。
L：城市。
<props="china">- ST：省份、直辖市或自治区。</props>
<props="intl">- ST：省份或州。</props>
CN：公用名

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results returned for a paginated query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页参数：结果集的最大数量

ShowSize.description_en: The number of certificates returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of client certificates and server certificates queried
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的客户端证书和服务端证书的总数量
